name: R041-pain-split-speed-tie
why: Challenge 7, every Pokemon has IV 31. The opponent's Misdreavus (set 374, Pain Split) has Speed 105 (base 85, Impish, no Speed EVs); the player's Heracross (set 424) also has Speed 105 and no Quick Claw. On turn 1 the player is at full HP, so AI_CV_PainSplit reaches if_target_faster, which draws Random() & 1 on the tie.
